paragraphs: Not a fan of monthly fees for software like Microsoft 365? This deal lands you a lifetime license to Microsoft Office Home & Business for Mac or PC at a big discount. Microsoft’s indispensable software suite includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and Outlook.
This early Black Friday deal lets you grab Microsoft Office Home & Business 2024 for just $199.97 (a 20% discount off the $249.99 list price).

This deal on Microsoft Office 2024 Home & Business gives you a lifetime license to classic applications that streamline workflow and enhance collaboration. And you won’t get hit with monthly fees, as you do with Apple One bundles for streaming services. Whether you’re drafting reports, crunching numbers or creating engaging presentations, this software suite can help you excel.

One of the most exciting aspects of Microsoft Office 2024 Home & Business is its offline functionality. Many remote workers and travelers face unreliable internet connections, making it challenging to stay productive. With genuine Microsoft apps installed directly on your computer, you can work seamlessly, whether you’re in a coffee shop, on a train or enjoying a work-from-home day.

This offline capability means your productivity isn’t hindered by connectivity problems. You can draft documents in Word, create spreadsheets in Excel or prepare presentations in PowerPoint without interruption, no matter where you go.

Security is paramount when handling sensitive information, and Microsoft Office 2024 Home & Business prioritizes your data protection with enhanced security features. Added protection against XLL add-ins in Excel helps safeguard your data from potential threats.

With new features like enhanced session recovery in Word and dynamic charts in Excel, Microsoft Office continues to evolve to meet the demands of modern workflows. Plus, innovative tools like Cameo for live camera feeds in PowerPoint give you much more to work with than older versions of Office did.
Improved search functionality in Outlook makes finding important emails quicker, while improved scheduling options make your life easier.
